description: This file defines the MatchDetailsActivity class, a UI activity for displaying detailed match information in an Android app. It sets up the UI layout and hosts a fragment that shows expanded match details.

classes.name: MatchDetailsActivity
classes.description: An activity that displays detailed information about a sports match, hosting MatchDetailsFragment and passing intent extras as arguments.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and adds the MatchDetailsFragment if there is no saved instance state.
